notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental funds statement (p3-p4, Total Governmental Funds column) used for receipts/disbursements; beginning/ending cash = fund balances (cash only: cash 2,962,862 + county treasurer 306,788 at end). Statement total column prints transfers blank (General Fund -60,000, other funds +60,000); recorded as transfers_in/out 60,000 each (net zero). Identity: 3,057,897 + 4,809,901 - 4,598,148 = 3,269,650. 'Other receipts' 12,488 split using General Fund schedule (p7-8) plus School Nutrition other receipts 671 (p13); the split ties to 12,488. Balance sheet uses the net position portion of the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2); no liabilities reported (cash basis). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (pp7-10) used instead of the p6 combining schedule (no double counting); lines with only a budget amount and no actual were skipped. The p6 reclassification column shows 310,000 of General Fund spending lines that is really transfer to Depreciation (300,000, p11) and Employee Benefit (10,000, p12) funds; recorded as contra expenditure lines per function group plus an other financing line (-310,000), and the explicit 60,000 interfund transfer (8000) as other financing; GF expenditure items 4,039,407 - 310,000 + 370,000 transfers = printed total 4,099,407. Activities Fund spending is on one line (no printed total on p14, so none recorded); Special Building has a single expenditure line (no total). Employee Benefit fund prints no total receipts line. QCPUF (p19, columns labelled 2024/2023), Cooperative (p20) and Student Fee (p21) funds had no FY2025 activity. Activity fund 123,371 spending is shown by the statement under Student support services. Statement of Activities p1 shows the same totals by function. Read pages 1-21 of 21
